C-SURFACE-OWNERSHIP.Summary: Close the editor-surface ownership debt of wave-5 bundle B: the answer to "which surface is this" and the answer to "what does closed mean" are each derived independently at dozens of sites instead of owned in one place, so every new surface axis (preview, lock, mirror, split focus, rendered identity, window closing) drifts into its own re-derivation with provably redundant disjuncts already living in shipped guards. This change collapses the four surface-vocabulary families of components/editorWithTabs/editor.vue (modal read-only, split/source focus, save authority, rendered identity) into one file-local surface-ownership helper that every guard site consumes instead of re-deriving (behavior-preserving by inclusion: the redundant `locked` and `mirror` disjuncts of the shortcut and undo/redo guards are absorbed by the predicate they already sit next to), and unifies the live-document closure volume of src/renderer/src/store/editor.js into one deactivate path that every closure entry routes through: FORCE_CLOSE_TAB deactivates a matching active binding synchronously with the tab splice (today a closed stream tab leaves a dangling active binding until a later PATCH heals it lazily), _commitDocumentWindow deactivates through the same path when the window close commits, and CLOSE_LIVE_DOCUMENT keeps its documented stream-end shape (binding only, the tab remains as an explicit-save document) now written down as the decided vocabulary rather than implicit. One owner per answer, one closure volume per entry, pinned by a failing-first eager-deactivation unit test and by the existing neighbor suites staying green without weakened assertions.

Goals.Goal: One surface-ownership helper (F-001). A single file-local surface-ownership helper in editor.vue is the only place that defines the four surface answers: the read-only axis (preview, locked, mirror), the split/source axis (followsStore, unified, sourceFocused), the save-authority axis (isAuthoritative, consumed from the C-SPLIT-SAVE-AUTHORITY registration at :811-813) and the rendered-identity axis (renderedTabId/renderedDocumentOwner with the existing mismatch rule of START_BLOCK_RENDER_OWNER_MISMATCH :3351-3359). Every guard site in the file consumes that helper instead of re-deriving its answer. The provably redundant disjuncts disappear: the shortcut guards :712 and :743 read the predicate alone (their currentFile.value?.locked disjunct is absorbed by inclusion), the undo/redo guards :1549 and :1563 read the predicate alone (their props.mirror disjunct likewise), and the follow-sync gates :872/:941 keep their exact combined condition sourced from the owned definitions. Every guard site keeps its own early-return, refusal, marker and answer-channel behavior byte-identically; the jumpClick chain keeps its nine conjuncts but reads each from the owned definitions; the ext targeting and export-pin consumers keep their exact contracts. No new guard semantics, no new surface axis, no behavior change of any kind is claimed for this goal.

One closure volume for the live document (F-013 remainder). store/editor.js gains one deactivate path for the live-document binding and every closure entry routes through it: FORCE_CLOSE_TAB deactivates a matching active binding synchronously with the tab splice, so closing a streamed tab leaves no dangling active binding (the store's liveDocument binding is store-private, verified: no consumer outside the store reads it); _commitDocumentWindow deactivates through the same path when the window close commits; CLOSE_LIVE_DOCUMENT keeps its exact stream-end shape (binding only, the streamed tab remains as a requiresExplicitSave document) and this shape is recorded as the decided vocabulary in the module contract rather than left implicit. The lazy PATCH heal at :1730 stays as defense-in-depth and its pin (tests/renderer/store/live-stream-ownership.test.js:60-72) stays green. The eager deactivation logs one count-only debug marker in the existing BLOCK_ convention carrying tab and session identifiers only, never document content or user paths.

Governance: the file-local markup of both touched files is updated in the same bundle as the code (editor.vue MODULE_CONTRACT SCOPE gains the one-surface-answer sentence, MODULE_MAP names the helper, CHANGE_SUMMARY gains the change entry, VERSION :86 bumped per the modification checklist; editor.js CHANGE_SUMMARY gains the entry); .grace/graph/runtime.xml gains the M-011 SummaryDelta and .grace/verification/runtime.xml gains the V-M-011 scenario entries naming the new tests; no version, release, tag or publication is authorized by this specification.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No renderer visual redesign of any kind: no CSS, geometry, layout, spacing, focus outline, theme or typography change; the surface work is predicate sourcing and closure vocabulary only, invisible to the user except through the marker log.

No new features: no new surface mode, no new command, notice, dialog or preference; the only behavior delta in the whole bundle is the eager binding deactivation on tab and window close (silent, marker-only, store-private state). Scout probe gap 7 (a 600x400 viewport geometry probe for the outline rail and split divider) is deliberately left open here; it is a probe gap of bundles B/D, not a confirmed defect of this change.

No muya internals: no file under the muya tree is written; the muya-facing surface contracts (setMarkdown render-only mode, the contentState history ownership, the linkInteraction lifetime) are consumed exactly as they are.
No locale changes: no new user-facing string in any of the ten locales; the new marker is console-only and count-only (tab and session identifiers); the locale-keys suite stays green untouched.
No dependency changes: no package.json, no Cargo.toml, no new import beyond the file's existing deps; no release version, tags or publication work, and no train accounting.

Not redoing delivered neighbors: no export-pin work (bundle A delivered as #329), no session-durability work (#325), no ext-targeting redesign (C-SEC-EDIT-TARGETING), no link-activation semantics change (C-MD-LINK-TABS), no save-authority change (C-SPLIT-SAVE-AUTHORITY, isAuthoritative consumed verbatim), no width-pipeline semantic change (C-PAGE-WIDTH-TABLES), no reload-admission change (C-EXTERNAL-RELOAD-OPERATION), no CLOSE_LIVE_DOCUMENT semantic redesign (the tab-remains stream-end vocabulary is documented, not changed), no store-side relocation of the documentWindowClosing truth (the single store field :224 stays the window-close answer for the store's six guards).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Failing-first closure pin: tests/renderer/store/live-stream-ownership.test.js pins force_close_tab_deactivates_a_live_binding_eagerly (OPEN_LIVE_DOCUMENT then FORCE_CLOSE_TAB of the live tab; immediately after the close returns, store.liveDocument.active is false with no PATCH in between) – red on the pre-change tree, where the binding stays active until the lazy heal at editor.js:1730. Companion pins hold the neighborhood: force_close_tab_of_an_unrelated_tab_keeps_the_live_binding (a sibling tab's close never touches a live binding), commit_document_window_deactivates_the_live_binding, and close_live_document_keeps_its_documented_shape (binding-only deactivation, the tab remains). The existing five pins of the suite, including the lazy-heal pin at :60-72, stay green unchanged.

Predicate-collapse proof (behavior-preserving, recorded honestly): the redundant disjuncts at editor.vue:712/:743 and :1549/:1563 are gone, with the guards reading the single predicate (inclusion-provable behavior identity: locked and mirror are disjuncts of the predicate at :586); a structural assertion (the new editor-surface-ownership suite or the plan's named equivalent) demonstrates that the four surface answers each have exactly one definition site in editor.vue and that the guard sites consume it; no behavioral red-first is claimed for this criterion, recorded honestly as a refactor pinned by the existing suites (the editor-format, editor-lock and split families, plus the e2e keyboard-selection and split-view specs) staying green byte-identically.

Closure-vocabulary documentation: the module contract of store/editor.js records the three closure entries and their volumes (FORCE_CLOSE_TAB and _commitDocumentWindow deactivate eagerly through the one path, CLOSE_LIVE_DOCUMENT deactivates the binding only and the streamed tab remains as a requiresExplicitSave document), and the editor.vue contract records the one-surface-answer ownership; a reader of the file-local markup can answer "what does closed mean" and "which surface is this" from one place each without reading the guard sites.

Neighbor-wave pins stay green without weakened assertions or budgets: the live-stream unit suite and e2e (closed-stream preservation), document-save-surfaces, the split family (unit and e2e), the editor store family, session-restore, session-close-commit, unsaved-close-actions, keyboard-selection, the export-pin and ext-targeting pins, and the #325 session pins all pass; graph ownership and verification (M-011 SummaryDelta, V-M-011 scenarios naming the new tests) describe the final implementation; grace lint --change C-SURFACE-OWNERSHIP passes target during implementation and final --run-commands before handoff.
